title: A $500 RL fine-tune of a 9B open model beat frontier models on catalog review
summary: A 9B open-source model was fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL) for just $500, outperforming frontier models (like GPT-4) on a catalog review task. The post details the RL training approach, cost breakdown, and surprising results, highlighting that small, targeted fine-tuning can beat massive general-purpose models on specific, well-defined tasks.
